text.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

words.gloss_range: confirmatory negative interrogative particle that governs the following jussive verb and turns the opening into recognition rather than an information request

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive second-person perception verb governed by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:a-lam}}) opens the surah by fusing question force with jussive negation before the perception verb arrives, with the initial glottal onset making recall begin in an audible arrest. The result is not an open request for information but a recognition-pressure frame: the listener is asked to acknowledge what the wording treats as already available. Because the compound governs {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}), the grammar makes the opening memory-like and assertive while still keeping the addressee inside the act of recognition; the familiar recognition formula is specialized here toward the elephant event.

topics.headline: question grammar presses affirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening question is already shaped as a demand for acknowledgment, not as a neutral request for information.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the compound as interrogative hamza plus jussive {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}), governing the following imperfect and producing rhetorical negative interrogation.

topics.headline: surah begins through recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah begins by making the addressee recognize a known pattern before any actor or target is named.
topics.reason: The first clause is the main interrogative frame, and the following clause is governed as its content, so the event is entered through addressed recognition.

topics.headline: formulaic opening with audible arrest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact opening as a familiar recognition formula whose first sound arrests attention before recall begins.
topics.reason: The particle fusion and formulaic force are compatible with the local syntax; the sound note is retained as a minor payoff attached to the opening function.

words.gloss_range: jussive second-person perception verb; locally perception is broadened into reflective recognition of how the act occurred rather than mere eyewitness sight
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, judging, opining, and vision; local grammar selects perception of manner inside a confirmatory question

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: manner interrogative governed by the perception verb
confirmatory negative interrogative governing the jussive verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}) completes the opening recognition formula by putting the addressee directly inside the question, and its second-person thread matches the later addressed divine title. Its clipped jussive surface carries the control of {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:a-lam}}), while its root range lets seeing mean reflective recognition rather than eyewitness reporting: the listener is asked to judge the manner of a known event, not merely to have watched it. Because it governs {{ar:كَيْفَ}} ({{tr:kayfa}}), the verb asks the listener to perceive the manner of the Lord's action; the standard surface smooths the root's middle hamza, while sukun-tightened and hamza-restoring variant reports expose different acoustic forms of the same jussive pressure. The recognition formula also places the elephant event beside the matching historical-action construction in 89:6 and anticipates the next jussive question in 105:2.

topics.headline: jussive addressee verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee is not outside the report; the verb is grammatically clipped and personally aimed.
topics.reason: The particle governs the verb in the jussive, and attachment evidence ties the second-person singular agreement to the inherent addressee.

topics.headline: seeing becomes reflective recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seeing here can mean grasping the manner and significance of a known event, not necessarily witnessing it with the eyes.
topics.reason: The verb takes the embedded manner question as its complement, which licenses perception as reflective recognition of how the action happened.

topics.headline: variants expose the hidden root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted variant surfaces can make the hidden root consonant or the jussive compression audible, while the standard local surface remains the controlling reading.
topics.reason: The variant evidence is useful as form-pressure and apparatus, but it does not replace the canonical aligned surface.

topics.headline: recognition formula and historical echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the common perception root is locally narrowed into a recognizable formula for surveying divine action, including the matching construction in 89:6.
topics.reason: Distributional evidence supports broad root frequency, while the local sequence and the named 89:6 comparator keep the payoff construction-specific.

topics.headline: perception launches the event clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb as the hinge that finishes the opening beat and sends attention into the manner clause and the next question in 105:2.
topics.reason: The first clause ends with the perception verb, which governs the embedded question and sets up the next rhetorical frame in 105:2.

words.gloss_range: embedded interrogative of manner that shifts the affirmed event from whether-it-happened to how-it-was-done

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed action verb whose manner is questioned

words.prose: {{ar:كَيْفَ}} ({{tr:kayfa}}) is the hinge between seeing and action. The outer question presses acknowledgment, but this word keeps a real manner question alive: the point is not whether the event occurred, but how {{ar:فَعَلَ}} ({{tr:faʿala}}) unfolded. Its fixed bare interrogative form, not a conditional use, holds the middle clause together and makes manner the pathway through which the action is to be recognized; it also begins the compact middle cadence before the heavier final target phrase.

topics.headline: manner is the question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah presupposes the act and asks the audience to attend to its mode.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as adverbial to the action verb inside the embedded question governed by the perception verb.

topics.headline: bare interrogative, not conditional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the stable bare form asks about quality of action, while conditional uses elsewhere do not control this local parse.
topics.reason: The local surface is an embedded interrogative of manner, so broader conditional possibilities are only a contrast.

topics.headline: pivot into the action clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word as the pivot that turns recognition into a compact action scene before the target is named.
topics.reason: The clause architecture places the manner word between the perception verb and the central action phrase.

words.gloss_range: completed divine action stated with a broad action verb, with no direct object and with the affected group routed through the following preposition
words.root_gloss_range: doing, acting, making, effecting, conduct, and grammatical object terminology; local Form I perfect selects broad completed action without derived-form intensification or reciprocity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional target complement of the action
manner interrogative that makes the action's mode central
explicit addressed divine subject of the action

words.prose: {{ar:فَعَلَ}} ({{tr:faʿala}}) names the Lord's act as completed, but it withholds the direct object that would immediately say what was done. That omission is not vagueness: {{ar:كَيْفَ}} ({{tr:kayfa}}) makes the manner central, {{ar:بِأَصْحَٰبِ}} ({{tr:bi-aṣḥābi}}) routes the target through a contact-bearing preposition instead of a bare done-to object, and 105:2-3 begin to specify the deed. The broad Form I action verb chooses doing or effecting before naming destruction or punishment, keeps the intervention one-sided rather than causative, reciprocal, or passive, and visibly ties the compact action-actor unit to {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}), including the matching historical-intervention construction in 89:6.

topics.headline: completed action with withheld content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deed is grammatically complete yet narratively withheld, so the ayah creates controlled attention to how the action will be shown.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect Form I with no explicit direct object, and the bundle flags the following ayahs as the reading window that specifies the action.

topics.headline: target routed through the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the elephant people are affected through a prepositional route rather than made a bare direct object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the governed prepositional complement as the target, while the verb instance records no direct object.

topics.headline: broad action root, locally constrained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording chooses a broad action verb so the impact can unfold, while local grammar keeps the sense to completed effecting rather than every root branch.
topics.reason: V4 supports a broad doing/effecting branch for the root, but the local Form I perfect and complement frame select completed action rather than technical or unrelated branches.

topics.headline: active Form I keeps agency visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the active Form I avoids causative, reciprocal, or passive alternatives and keeps the Lord as the visible agent.
topics.reason: The aligned form is active perfect Form I, and the explicit following subject rules out passive suppression of agency.

topics.headline: formula points forward and outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same construction appears with another destroyed power in 89:6 and that 105:2-3 begin filling in the act left open here.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete references, and the local omission of the direct object makes the forward specification in 105:2-3 relevant without adding fallback routing.

topics.headline: action and actor fuse in the middle beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the central clause as a compact unit where manner, deed, and the Lord's agency arrive before the target phrase.
topics.reason: The action verb is inside the embedded manner clause with an explicit subject, and the sound observation is locally tied to that action-actor sequence.

words.gloss_range: addressed divine title meaning your Lord, the explicit subject of the action and a relational authority tied to the addressee
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, mastery, nurturing, managing, bringing to completion, and related concrete branches; local noun selects divine lordship with nurturing-management pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second-person perception verb sharing the addressee thread

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}) names the actor only after the action verb has pulled the listener forward, and the doubled b gives the title a compressed firmness when it lands. The suffix keeps the same addressee from {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}) inside the divine title, so the action is not by an abstract lord but by your Lord in the address. The root's lordship and nurturing-management range makes the intervention relational: the one who sustains and brings to completion is also the explicit agent acting against the elephant people, while the root-family image of concentration makes that management feel like a process brought to its decisive essence. As explicit subject in 105:1, this title also carries forward into the divine acts of 105:2-3 and belongs to the same your-Lord action pattern seen in 89:6.

topics.headline: your Lord, not an abstract title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine actor is grammatically bound to the addressee by the suffix, continuing the personal address from the perception verb.
topics.reason: The noun is definite through construct with the second-person suffix, and cross-reference evidence ties that suffix to the same singular addressee.

topics.headline: subject names the actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the actor is delayed until after the deed-frame but then made explicit before the target phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the nominative subject of the action verb and places it between the action and the target complement.

topics.headline: nurturing authority acts protectively
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lordship here carries nurturing and managing pressure, so punitive action against the target is read through protection of the addressed relation.
topics.reason: V4 supports lordship and nurture/completion branches, while the local noun and suffix select the divine title rather than unrelated concrete branches.

topics.headline: concentrated-management image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a concrete management image in the root family, where process and concentration reinforce the question about how the Lord acted.
topics.reason: The image can remain as root-family pressure, but local grammar keeps the selected sense as the addressed divine title.

topics.headline: noun makes lordship a standing relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names an established relation before the specific action is interpreted.
topics.reason: The local form is a noun in construct with a suffix, not a verbal form of rearing or managing.

topics.headline: divine actor carries through the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named Lord belongs to a recognition-and-action formula, including 89:6, and supplies the understood actor for the following acts in 105:2-3.
topics.reason: The explicit subject in 105:1 and the concrete formula reference support a carried-forward actor without changing the local parse.

topics.headline: Lord stands opposite the characterized group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the relation between the firm divine title and the elephant-defined group as the ayah moves from actor to target.
topics.reason: The subject directly precedes the prepositional target phrase, and the sound note is locally attached to the naming of the actor.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition routing the affected group as the target of action, with contact/adversarial and mediated-means pressure in context

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: genitive target noun governed by the preposition
action verb whose target is routed through the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is small but structurally decisive. Since {{ar:فَعَلَ}} ({{tr:faʿala}}) has no direct object, this bound preposition is the route by which the action reaches {{ar:أَصْحَٰبِ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābi}}). In this frame it carries target-contact and adversarial pressure, while also leaving room for mediated means that the later verses disclose. Because it is proclitic on the target noun, target-marking and target-naming arrive as one bound phrase from the first sound of the final beat.

topics.headline: preposition supplies the target route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the affected group reaches the verb through a preposition rather than as a direct object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following noun as the prepositional complement of the action verb, while the verb instance has no direct object.

topics.headline: contact and means remain available
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle can make the action feel both directed against the group and mediated rather than a bare object impact.
topics.reason: The local construction licenses adversarial target-contact; broader prepositional functions are narrowed to what the verb and target phrase require.

topics.headline: bound particle opens the target beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that target marking and target naming arrive as one bound phrase from the first sound of the final beat.
topics.reason: The preposition is proclitic on the governed noun, so the phonetic observation reinforces a real syntactic dependency.

words.gloss_range: plural construct identity label for the people defined by the elephant, governed as the prepositional target of the action
words.root_gloss_range: companionship, close association, possession, protective accompaniment, and being in charge; local construct selects a group defined by association with and control of the elephant

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite genitive noun completing the group identity

words.prose: {{ar:أَصْحَٰبِ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābi}}) begins the final identity phrase, but it cannot complete that identity until {{ar:ٱلْفِيلِ}} ({{tr:al-fīli}}) arrives. The plural construct makes the target a collective, elephant-defined faction rather than a set of named individuals, and {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) fixes that faction as the affected target. The root's association and custody range keeps the label stronger than casual companionship: these are people characterized by possession, control, and operational attachment to the elephant. The familiar people-of formula is made local by a unique filler, and the paired genitive endings and long vowels make the final phrase sound bonded as well as grammatically bound.

topics.headline: construct phrase defines the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group identity is incomplete without the final elephant noun, so the phrase itself binds people to instrument.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a syntactically forced construct relation between the plural head and the definite genitive complement.

topics.headline: genitive target under the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the social label is also the grammatical target of the divine action.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preposition as complement of the action verb, so it is neither subject nor free label.

topics.headline: association becomes custody and control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that companionship in this construct carries possession, custody, and control pressure rather than friendly company.
topics.reason: V4 supports association and protective accompaniment branches, while the local construct with the elephant selects characterization by controlled association.

topics.headline: people-of formula gathers the faction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar people-of formula being used to gather the whole faction under one defining attachment.
topics.reason: Distributional evidence shows this noun form strongly favors construct use, and the CRITICAL formula claim is locally instantiated by the construct phrase.

topics.headline: many people defined by one emblem
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how a plural group is grammatically collected under one singular elephant identifier.
topics.reason: The local phrase combines a plural construct head with a singular definite genitive complement.

topics.headline: final phrase is bonded in sound and relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the group standing opposite the Lord's action while the genitive cadence audibly binds the group to the elephant.
topics.reason: The relational and cadence claims are locally grounded in the adjacent construct phrase and the actor-target sequence.

words.gloss_range: the definite elephant, the singular genitive identifier completing the group label and concentrating the event's emblematic military force
words.root_gloss_range: elephant is the locally selected branch; other root branches include weakness of judgment, a hip/thigh term, and a hiding game, which are not active in this noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct head whose identity this noun completes

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفِيلِ}} ({{tr:al-fīli}}) lands the ayah on the definite animal that completes the people-of phrase, with the article making it a known event-specific instrument rather than any elephant. Its singularity matters twice: one emblematic elephant defines a plural faction, and the word itself is a Quranic hapax, so its whole Quranic identity is concentrated here as the surah's lexical title anchor. The local branch is the elephant, not the other root branches, but the definite, possibly foreign noun is fully naturalized by article, genitive case, and construct governance; its swollen-excess pressure and long final sound make the military instrument feel heavy at closure. That final emblem of force is then answered by birds and stones in 105:3-4.

topics.headline: final noun completes the identity phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the elephant is not loose imagery but the syntactic key that completes the group's identity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as the genitive complement in the construct phrase.

topics.headline: the elephant, not any elephant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the article makes the final noun point to a known event-specific instrument, not a generic animal.
topics.reason: The word is definite with the article and genitive inside the construct phrase.

topics.headline: concrete emblem of overwhelming force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the animal names the faction through its visible military instrument rather than through tribe, ruler, or abstract power.
topics.reason: V4 identifies the elephant branch as the locally relevant branch, and the construct phrase makes the animal the group's identifier.

topics.headline: swollen and foreign instrument pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices possible overgrown-force and foreign-instrument pressure, while the local selected sense remains the definite elephant.
topics.reason: These rows can survive as lexical pressure, but V4 and local syntax select the elephant branch rather than replacing the noun with disease or etymology.

topics.headline: one unique noun concentrates the event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one singular definite noun defines many people and appears only here in the Quran, concentrating the event's identity in one word.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the root as a single occurrence, and the local phrase combines singular definite noun with plural construct head.

topics.headline: unique filler in a familiar formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar people-of formula receives a singular, non-recurrent filler here.
topics.reason: The formulaic payoff is grounded in the construct phrase, while uniqueness belongs to the final noun.

topics.headline: heavy final emblem awaits reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing on the heavy emblem of force that will be answered by birds and stones in 105:3-4.
topics.reason: The word is ayah-final, and the CRITICAL rows give the concrete later contrast in 105:3-4.

topics.headline: surah-confined title anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same unique final noun also functions as the surah's defining lexical anchor.
topics.reason: The root is attested once in the Quran and appears at the surah's opening identification.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative interrogative أَلَمْ تَرَ ... كَيْفَ binds perception to the manner of رَبُّكَ's فعل.
baseline_models.mechanism: Seeing or insight and the alerting question make the deed cognitively present; branchless كَيْفَ structurally keeps its manner open, while فعل and lordship supply intentional governing agency.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing or insight makes the clause demand apprehension rather than passive receipt of information.
The alerting tell-me use turns the interrogative into a summons to attend to how the deed worked.
The production of an act supplies the event whose operative manner must be grasped.
Ownership and sovereignty locate the act within governing agency rather than anonymous occurrence.

changed_reading.before: A question asking whether the addressee literally witnessed a past event.
changed_reading.after: A summons to grasp the manner of a lordly deed as present, inspectable evidence, whether or not it was literally witnessed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبُّكَ and أَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ place two relations of possession or association on opposite sides of فَعَلَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is related to a sovereign who owns, tends, and completes, while the acted-upon people are named through sustained attachment to an elephant. The verse therefore contrasts two constitutive relations, not merely two named parties.

activation_trace.role: Mastery and ownership make رَبُّكَ the governing relation set against the other group's attachment.
Tending, correction, and completion add sustained ordering to lordship's action.
Close association makes the people identifiable through what they accompany or possess.
Taking or carrying something along makes the elephant an incorporated instrument of the collective.
The concrete elephant supplies the conspicuous power-object around which the collective is named.

changed_reading.before: أَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ is only a label for a group present with an elephant.
changed_reading.after: The focus is a relational confrontation: people constituted by attachment to a power-bearing instrument are acted upon by the addressee's owning and ordering Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَرَ can hold direct or inward seeing while its non-dominant split mapping activates transmission of a report.
baseline_models.mechanism: Perception and narration coexist: a transmitted event can be rhetorically re-presented until it functions as sight. The question need not choose between eyewitnessing and report; it can convert the latter into the former's evidentiary force.

activation_trace.role: Sensory or insightful seeing supplies the immediacy claimed by تَرَ.
The non-dominant report-and-poetry branch supplies transmission as the medium through which the event becomes present.

changed_reading.before: Seeing and hearing a report are rival explanations of the address.
changed_reading.after: The received narrative is made cognitively visible: transmission does not weaken the evidence but becomes its vehicle.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَرَ invites judgment, while الْفِيلِ has both the animal branch and a branch of slack or mistaken discernment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The most visible emblem of physical mass can carry an ironic counter-image of poor judgment. The addressee is asked to look through conspicuous scale and assess the discernment of those defined by it.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment makes seeing an evaluation of the collective's reasoning.
The elephant supplies visible magnitude and the group's explicit identifying instrument.
Slack or mistaken judgment supplies an ironic weakness concealed by that magnitude.

changed_reading.before: The elephant contributes zoological identification and an impression of scale.
changed_reading.after: The label can carry an ironic double activation: massive visible power coupled to weak discernment, inviting judgment of its companions rather than awe at the animal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The broad فعل of 105:1 is specified as a transformation whose patient is the companions' own stratagem: purposive contrivance is made to occupy a state of misdirection and loss. The action works inside the plan's organization rather than only striking its agents from outside.

activation_trace.role: An effected deed leaves its precise operation open for the context to specify.
Making something assume a state supplies the conversion operator applied to the plot.
Calculated contrivance supplies an internally organized plan capable of being reversed.
Deviation from direction supplies the failed trajectory into which the plan is made.
Loss supplies the terminal disappearance of the plot's intended yield.

structural_cues: 105:2 repeats أَلَمْ and answers the branchless كَيْفَ of 105:1 with a transformation clause.
The possessive object كَيْدَهُمْ keeps the operation anchored to أَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transformation, contrivance, deviation, and loss; I infer the directional arrow that the plan's own organization becomes the site of its defeat. A live alternative is simple external cancellation without reflexive reversal.

changed_reading.before: The Lord performed an unspecified deed against the elephant's companions.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's deed penetrates their plan and converts its designed direction into the very state of failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-only irony of great bulk with weak discernment gains a causal test: effortful, calculated strategy terminates in deviation. Failure is not caused by absence of planning; planning itself reveals misjudgment under the addressee's reflective gaze.

activation_trace.role: Reflection and evaluative judgment position the addressee to assess strategic intelligence.
Mistaken discernment supplies the exploratory weakness that context can test.
Severe exertion prevents the failure from reading as mere lack of effort.
Cunning supplies deliberate strategic intelligence whose adequacy is being tested.
Departure from the intended course supplies the observable verdict on that intelligence.

structural_cues: The plural possessive in كَيْدَهُمْ assigns the strategy to the same collective named in 105:1.
فِي تَضْلِيلٍ presents failure as an encompassing result-state rather than a single missed move.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflective judgment, a form-distant weakness branch, strenuous cunning, and deviation; I infer that strategic failure exposes defective discernment. The alternative is to leave the ف ي ل weakness branch inactive and read only external overpowering.

changed_reading.before: The elephant's scale may ironically coexist with weak judgment.
changed_reading.after: The irony becomes operational: a worked-out strategy, not raw impulse, is precisely what discloses the companions' miscalculation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to see is answered by images of hiding and loss. What becomes perceptible is a negative trace: the intended outcome does not arrive, so cognition moves from visible absence back to the agency that made the plan vanish.

activation_trace.role: Seeing or insight establishes the focus's demand for evidence.
Disappearance and concealment turn non-arrival into the paradoxical thing to be seen.
Loss supplies the missing effect from which the reader infers the counter-action.

structural_cues: The repeated أَلَمْ aligns the focus's seeing question with the context's failed result.
The focus asks how, while 105:2 first answers through what no longer reaches its goal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, concealment, and loss; I infer an evidentiary arrow from absent outcome to effective counter-agency. A live alternative confines ض ل ل to wrong direction and does not activate absence as evidence.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the deed requires a positively displayed spectacle.
changed_reading.after: The deed can also be seen abductively in a vanished outcome: the failure to arrive is itself the trace of how the Lord acted.

context_deltas.mechanism: A collective named by close attachment to one conspicuous heavy animal is answered by agents defined through dispatch, aerial lightness, spreading, and grouped multiplicity. The contrast makes organization itself part of the كيف: centralized attached bulk meets distributed mobility.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association gives the acted-upon collective a cohesive identity around its companion-object.
The elephant supplies the singular conspicuous center of that attached identity.
Dispatch and emission supply an externally directed counter-agency.
Light flight supplies mobility that contrasts with elephant-centered mass.
Spreading after light movement supplies distributed coverage rather than one concentrated front.
Successive groups organize the light agents as plural waves rather than an undifferentiated flock.

structural_cues: عَلَيْهِمْ directs the dispatched plurality back onto the companions named in 105:1.
The collective noun طَيْرًا qualified by أَبَابِيلَ places one mode of collectivity against another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, elephant, dispatch, flight, spreading, and groups; I infer that asymmetry of organization is a mechanism of the reversal. The live alternative treats these cues as zoological description without contrasting force architectures.

changed_reading.before: The Lord acts on an elephant-associated collective by an as-yet unspecified means.
changed_reading.after: The manner is an inversion in force architecture: attached bulk is answered by dispatched, mobile, distributed plurality.

context_deltas.mechanism: Directed throwing, hard matter, enclosure, full pouring, and fixing in a register combine into a model of saturation and closure. The Lord's فعل operates at range yet makes the advancing collective bounded and materially fixed.

activation_trace.role: The open deed receives a concrete delivery-and-containment mechanism from the context.
Sending and throwing supply force delivered from a distance.
Movement toward a goal lets the throwing read as targeted delivery rather than mere release.
Hard stone supplies the literal compact impact-material.
Prevention and enclosure give the impacts the functional role of stopping and bounding movement.
A full vessel pouring out supplies saturation by repeated material delivery.
A register that gathers and fixes supplies the exploratory image of defeat being made materially settled.

structural_cues: The feminine singular تَرْمِيهِمْ treats the distributed bird collective as one coordinated actuator.
Instrumental بِـ on the stones and material مِنْ on سِجِّيلٍ build a delivery chain from agent to target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies throwing, goal-directed motion, hardness, enclosure, pouring, and recording; I infer a coordinated arrow from delivery to saturation and closure. The live alternative needs only literal thrown hard stones and leaves enclosure and register as separate latent images.

changed_reading.before: The focus announces an unspecified overpowering act.
changed_reading.after: The act becomes a coordinated remote operation that stops movement, saturates the target, and fixes the defeat in matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated transformation verb carries the companions into a result-image of fragmented crop covering, wind-scattered matter, consumption, and decay. The endpoint does not merely defeat an intact collective; it dissolves the attachment and usable form by which the collective was named.

activation_trace.role: Close association supplies the coherent social relation that the result-state can undo.
Carrying something along makes loss of organized attachment part of the collective's unmaking.
Making the object assume a new state explicitly converts the companions rather than merely comparing them.
Fragmented crop husk and leaf supply a residue stripped of integral form.
Wind-driven scattering supplies loss of cohesion and common direction.
Being taken as food supplies the post-use condition of what has already served another process.
Erosion and corruption supply progressive loss of material integrity.

structural_cues: 105:5 repeats جَعَلَ from 105:2, closing the sequence with a visible result-state.
The object pronoun in جَعَلَهُمْ carries the companions of 105:1 into the final comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies association, transformation, crop fragments, scattering, consumption, and decay; I infer that dissolution reaches organized identity as well as material form. The live alternative limits the final image to visual bodily residue and leaves social de-association unstated.

changed_reading.before: The elephant's companions remain conceptually the same organized collective after being defeated.
changed_reading.after: The Lordly deed unmakes the relation that named them: attached instrument-bearers become scattered, post-use residue without collective form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote game branch beside the ordinary animal branch: something is hidden in divided soil and the player must identify its locus. It remains anchored to الْفِيلِ and the focus's alerting question, but downstream prose should present it only as a metareading of discernment and distraction, never as a lexical replacement for elephant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The alerting تَرَ construction asks the reader to discern how action occurred, while the ف ي ل inventory juxtaposes the visible animal with a game of finding a concealed object.

activation_trace.role: The alerting inquiry places the addressee in the position of one challenged to identify the operative answer.
The animal supplies the enormous obvious object that dominates first attention.
The hide-and-divide game supplies an exploratory contrast between the obvious object and the concealed decisive locus.

changed_reading.before: The elephant is simply the most visible item in the scene.
changed_reading.after: As a contained metareading, its very visibility can function as the distractor in a discernment problem: the reader must locate agency somewhere other than the largest object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the burden or liability branch of ء ب ل is collateral to the ordinary grouped أبابيل image, and the transfer arrow is reader-supplied. It remains anchored in the companions' carried attachment and in the sent birds and stones; render it as a secondary burden-reversal analogy, not as the gloss of أبابيل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ names people through a carried attachment to the heaviest visible creature, allowing later light agents to reverse who bears weight and consequence.

activation_trace.role: Taking or carrying something along makes the elephant an assumed attachment and load of identity.
The elephant supplies maximal visible weight on the companions' side of the relation.
Light flight supplies the paradoxically weightless carrier.
Weight and liability supply the consequence transferred through the grouped aerial formation.
Hard stone gives material weight to what the light carriers return upon the target.

changed_reading.before: Light birds simply transport small projectiles against a massive animal-centered group.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory reversal, distributed light agents return weight and liability upon those whose identity was built by carrying the heaviest attachment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading depends on non-dominant split mappings from ف ع ل to nurture and from ر ب ب to growth, so it is form-distant and cannot define the words' local senses. It remains anchored in فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ and is sharpened by the final plant residue; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy of selective cultivation, not an assertion of lexical identity or motive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ concentrates several tending, completion, nurture, and growth images around the agent and deed.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant fathering and nurture branch gives the deed a remote formative undertone.
Tending, correction, and completion supply the primary cultivation image around lordship.
The non-dominant nourishment and growth branch doubles the formative material register.
Spent crop husk supplies the endpoint of vegetation reduced after its integral use.
Agricultural yield keeps the result within a cultivation-and-consumption analogy.
Decay supplies the conversion of overgrown organized matter into unusable residue.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's deed is categorically opposed to nurture because its endpoint is destructive.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained material analogy, governance can appear as counter-cultivation: one order is tended by reducing an overgrown coercive formation to spent plant matter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the non-dominant ك ل ل target mapped from ء ك ل, so its dullness, enclosure, and hesitation cannot replace the ordinary consumed-residue sense. It remains useful because those images attach the final state back to the elephant-centered collective's operative capacity; render them as a split-root afterimage of strategic neutralization.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The companions are defined by an elephant-centered collective instrument, so the final result can be tested for what happens to that instrument's edge and momentum.

activation_trace.role: Association supplies the collective whose operative cohesion can be neutralized.
The elephant supplies the collective's concentrated instrument of movement and force.
Dullness and loss of sharpness supply neutralization of operative edge.
Total enclosure supplies comprehensive containment of the once-cohesive force.
Suspension between proceeding and retreat supplies the final loss of strategic momentum.

changed_reading.before: مَأْكُولٍ contributes only the image of matter already consumed.
changed_reading.after: As a form-distant afterimage, the result is also strategic dulling and total enclosure: the formation loses its edge and stalls between advance and retreat.

strongest_changes: The open question about what the Lord did becomes a precise reversal in which the companions' own designed plan is made to lose direction.
The focus's attached elephant-centered bulk is reread against dispatched, light, distributed groups and then against the dissolution of companionship into scattered residue.
Seeing expands from literal spectacle to report-mediated presence and, more abductively, to inference from the plan's conspicuous non-arrival.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah organizes its surprise through relations and manner: رَبُّكَ faces أَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ across an initially open فعل, and the context repeatedly specifies making, dispatch, delivery, and result. This allows causal reversal, force architecture, material decomposition, and epistemic evidence to remain coexisting readings; non-dominant split roots add contained echoes of report, weak judgment, cultivation, burden, dulling, and stalled movement.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant ر و ي, ء ب و, ر ب و, and ك ل ل mappings may be productive resonances or only form-distant packet affordances; they should remain visibly qualified.
The enclosure and register images in 105:4 may form one saturation-and-closure mechanism or remain independent alternatives beside literal hard projectiles.
The final residue certainly changes material form, but extending that change to the collective's social identity is an abductive step rather than an explicit grammatical assertion.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The ayah as an instruction to inspect a mechanism, not merely recall an event.** Lexical evidence: ر ء ي B001, seeing by eye or insight; ر ء ي B012, showing and making seen; ر ء ي B013, "tell me" formula; ف ع ل B001, bringing an act into being. ك ي ف has no accepted non-contaminated branch inventory in the packet, so I use it only as the surface interrogative "how" and do not assign a branch ID. Structural cue: 105:1 asks about manner before 105:2-5 give sequential operations: making the plot lost, sending birds, throwing stones, making them chaff. Assigned role: ر ء ي makes the reader/viewer an observer of staged causation; ف ع ل names the whole sequence as an effected act. Abductive move: I infer that the later ayat are the answer to "how"; the packet supplies the order, while I supply the forensic reading of that order. Reading change: "أَلَمْ تَرَ" reads less as simple "did you not see" and more as "watch the way the action is made visible."

2. **Lordship as corrective administration.** Lexical evidence: ر ب ب B001, lordship, ownership, and authority; ر ب ب B002, repair, nurture, and completion; ج ع ل B002 in 105:2 and 105:5, turning something into a state; ض ل ل B001/B003, going astray from aim and losing/failing to locate. Structural cue: "رَبُّكَ" occurs before two instances of جعل that convert their كيد into تضليل and then convert them into عصف مأكول. Assigned role: ر ب ب B001 supplies sovereign capacity; ر ب ب B002 supplies a caretaker's power to set a damaged order right. Abductive move: I supply that the two later make/turn operations are administrative acts of the Lord, not separate narrative facts. Reading change: the Lord's "doing" reads as a corrective governance of states and outcomes, not only an overwhelming blow.

3. **"Companions of the elephant" as exposed dependence.** Lexical evidence: ص ح ب B001, companionship and close association; ص ح ب B004, making something accompany or carrying it along; ف ي ل B004, the elephant; ف ي ل B001, slackness and weak judgment. Structural cue: the human group is identified by companionship with the animal before their كيد is placed in تضليل. Assigned role: ص ح ب binds the group identity to what it accompanies; ف ي ل B004 supplies visible bulk, while ف ي ل B001 supplies a latent weakness of judgment activated by the later lost plot. Abductive move: I infer that the phrase does not merely label ownership but reveals the support system by which they understand themselves. Reading change: "أصحاب الفيل" becomes a diagnosis of dependence on heavy animal power and weak discernment, not a neutral historical tag.

4. **Mighty animal force inverted by airborne and granular force.** Lexical evidence: ف ي ل B004, elephant; ط ي ر B001 in 105:3, airborne lightness and birds; ء ب ل B003, successive or scattered groups; ر م ي B001 and ح ج ر B003 in 105:4, casting hard stones. Structural cue: a single emblematic ground animal in 105:1 is answered by many airborne groups and small hard projectiles in 105:3-4. Assigned role: the elephant supplies mass and ground-bound prestige; the birds and stones supply distributed vertical force. Abductive move: I infer a reversal between the mode of confidence and the mode of defeat; the packet supplies animal/bird/projectile imagery, while I supply the directional inversion. Reading change: the ayah starts to read as the setup of a material reversal: weight below is overcome by lightness above carrying hardness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The final جعل in 105:5 was the strongest retrospective correction: it made 105:1's "فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ" less like a single deed and more like a chain of transformations. 105:3's أبابيل also revised "أصحاب الفيل": the elephant-company was not only defeated by birds, but by a rival pattern of association, scattered and successive rather than heavy and centralized. The missing ك ي ف inventory remained important: the "how" had to be supplied structurally from the sequence, not lexically by invented branches.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Seeing becomes causal recognition.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `تَرَ` carries `ر ء ي` B001, “seeing by eye or insight,” and B002, “opinion and reflective judgment.” **Structural cue:** the interrogative `كَيْفَ` is followed by an ordered answer: the plot is displaced, aerial groups are sent, they cast stones, and the actors reach a new material state. **Assigned role:** B001 makes the outcome perceptible, while B002 makes the sequence an object of reasoning. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies effects and their order; I infer that those effects make the otherwise unstated operation cognitively visible. **Reading change:** `أَلَمْ تَرَ` need not be restricted to eyewitness sight; it asks the addressee to reconstruct agency from a causal demonstration.

2. **The broad verb `فَعَلَ` unfolds into a staged operation.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `فَعَلَ` carries `ف ع ل` B001, “bringing an act into being”; contextual `ج ع ل` B002 is “turning something into a state,” and `ر س ل` B001 is dispatch/release. **Structural cue:** the initially unspecified act is subsequently distributed over two `جعل` clauses with `أرسل` and `ترميهم` between them. **Assigned role:** B001 names the whole act, the two state-transformations mark its abstract and material endpoints, and dispatch supplies the intervening means. **Abductive move:** the packet gives the sequence; I infer that the later clauses unpack the earlier `فَعَلَ` rather than merely list unrelated events. **Reading change:** the Lord’s act reads as an organized process that changes strategy first and actors last, not as one undifferentiated blow.

3. **`رَبُّكَ` is activated as completing care as well as authority.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `رَبُّكَ` carries `ر ب ب` B001, “lordship, ownership, and authority,” and B002, “repair, nurture, and completion”; the opening repeats `ر ح م` B001. **Structural cue:** the second-person bond in `رَبُّكَ` stands between the invitation to see and the completed chain of intervention. **Assigned role:** B001 identifies the authoritative actor; B002 explains the actor’s sustained management; contextual mercy supplies the disposition under which that management is read. **Abductive move:** the packet does not name what is being preserved, so I infer only that defeating the presented plot is maintenance within the Lord-addressee relation. **Reading change:** `رَبُّكَ` becomes the title of an involved governor who carries a counter-process to completion, not merely a rank of power.

4. **The elephant label contains an internal reversal of judgment.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ٱلْفِيلِ` directly realizes `ف ي ل` B004, “the elephant,” while dormant B001 is “slackness and weakness,” specifically weak or mistaken judgment. **Structural cue:** the group named by the elephant is immediately followed by `كَيْدَهُمْ` being placed in `تَضْلِيلٍ`. **Assigned role:** B004 supplies the group’s conspicuous material affiliation; B001 supplies a latent cognitive defect exposed by the failure of its strategy. **Abductive move:** I allow a dormant branch of the same root to color the animal label because the next ayah explicitly evaluates the group’s planning; this paronomastic link is exploratory, not a replacement of “elephant.” **Reading change:** the apparent emblem of massive force simultaneously forecasts failed discernment.

5. **Companionship becomes operational coupling.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `أَصْحَٰبِ` carries `ص ح ب` B001, “companionship and close association,” including possession or charge. **Structural cue:** the plural possessive in `كَيْدَهُمْ` treats the elephant-associated people as one planning body, while `طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ` later presents a counter-collective organized in groups. **Assigned role:** B001 binds people, animal power, and plan into one operating formation. **Abductive move:** the packet gives association and a collective strategy; I infer that the association is functional rather than a loose label. **Reading change:** `أَصْحَابِ ٱلْفِيلِ` reads as a coupled human-animal apparatus confronted by a differently organized animal collective.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 105:2 supplied the sharpest surprise: `كَيْدَهُمْ ... تَضْلِيلٍ` activated the weak-judgment branch `ف ي ل` B001 inside the otherwise literal elephant label. Then 105:5’s repeated `ج ع ل` B002 retrospectively organized `فَعَلَ` into paired state changes, while 105:3’s grouped birds showed that `أَصْحَاب` names one operational collective facing another rather than a merely incidental association.

baseline.text: Rabbinin fil sahiplerine ne yaptığını görmedin mi?

findings.text: Görmek, gözle tanıklıkla sınırlı kalmaz; sonraki aşamalardan hareketle eyleyen gücü ve nedensel düzeni kavramaya çağrıya dönüşür.
Başta genel bırakılan yapma eylemi, planın etkisizleştirilmesinden grubun maddi dönüşümüne uzanan aşamalı bir işlem olarak açılır.
Rablik, yalnız üstün yetki değil, karşı süreci sonuna kadar yürüten düzeltici ve tamamlayıcı yönetim olarak belirginleşir.
Fil ile anılan topluluk, hayvan gücü, insanlar ve planın birbirine bağlandığı tek bir işleyen düzenek gibi görünür.
Filin ağır ve gösterişli gücü, yukarıdan gelen hafif taşıyıcılar ve küçük sert cisimlerle tersine çevrilecek maddi karşıtlığı baştan kurar.
Fil adı, başarısız planın açığa çıkardığı zayıf muhakemeyi de çağrıştırır.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **105:1.** أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, fil sahiplerine ne yapıldığını hatırlatmaktan çok, Rabbin fiilinin nasıl işlediğini görmeye çağırır. Sonraki جعل tekrarları, kuş sürüleri ve taş atışı bu fiili tek bir darbeden çıkarıp planı saptıran, güç düzenini tersine çeviren ve ağır fil topluluğunu hafif ama düzenli göksel güç karşısında çözen bir mekanizmaya dönüştürür. {ر ء ي B001; ر ء ي B012; ر ء ي B013; ف ع ل B001; ر ب ب B001; ر ب ب B002; ص ح ب B001; ص ح ب B004; ف ي ل B004; ف ي ل B001; ط ي ر B001; ء ب ل B003; ر م ي B001; ح ج ر B003}

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تراءي القوم أو الجمعين وتقابل المنازل والنيران بحيث يرى كل جانب الآخر
branches.source_phrase_ar: تراءى القوم إذا رأى بعضهم بعضا (maqayis)؛ تراءى القوم رأى بعضهم بعضا وتراءى لي فلان (ayn)؛ قوم رئاء وبيوتهم رئاء وتراءى الجمعان (sihah)؛ تراءينا أي تلاقينا فرأيته ورآني وداري ترى دار فلان (tahdhib)؛ تراءا الجمعان أي تقاربا وتقابلا ومنازلهم رئاء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir işi başkaları görsün diye yapmayı ve davranışı izleyicinin varlığına göre sürdürüp bırakmayı açıkça merkez alır. Yalnızca görünür olmak, ün kazanmak veya içindekini saklamak bu özel güdüyü tek başına karşılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Başkaları görsün diye davranma çekirdeği, bunu açıkça adlandıran söz öbeği ve türemiş eylemlerle sınırlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi kendi değeri için değil, başkaları görüp beğensin diye yapmak ve davranışı izleyicinin varlığına göre sergilemektir. Görülmediğinde bırakılan ibadet, bu güdünün belirgin bir örneğidir.

facets.statement: Bir davranışı başkaları görsün ve beğensin diye sergileme.
İzleyen varken davranışı yapıp izleyen yokken bırakma.
Görülme isteğini zorlayarak ve yapmacık biçimde üretme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tanımı, eylemin başkalarının bakışına sunulması ve görülme amacıyla yapılmasıdır; izleyiciye göre davranışı yapıp bırakma bu güdüyü somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir davranışın gerçek amacı başkalarının görmesi ve olumlu değerlendirmesi olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemi, izleyiciyi ve görülme güdüsünü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Davranışın içten bir amaçtan çok başkalarının beğenisine yöneldiği genel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapmacık sergilemeyi ve başkalarının bakışını amaçlama yönünü korur.
Başkalarınca bilinme sonucuna uzaktan değinir.
error_profile.loses: Davranışı görülme amacıyla sergileme güdüsünü ve koşulunu siler.
error_profile.adds: Eylemden bağımsız kalıcı tanınmışlık sonucu ekler.
error_profile.collision: Toplumsal tanınmışlık alanıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir davranışı görülmek ve beğenilmek amacıyla sergileme güdüsü.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İçteki karşıt tutumu saklayıp dışarıda başka bir bağlılık görüntüsü verme.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal dışarıya sunulan davranışla iç amaç arasında ayrılık içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı yönü görülme ve beğenilme isteğidir; komşu dalın ayırıcı yönü içtekinin tersini göstererek gizlemektir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür davranışı izleyici için sergilemeye uzanan genel güdü.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ölü, aşırı alçak gönüllü veya güçsüz görünme gibi belirli yapmacık rolleri kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gerçeğe uymayan bir görünüşü başkalarına sunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görülme amacıyla yapılan davranışın genel adıdır; komşu dal belirli bir ölülük veya boyun eğme görünüşünü takınmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Başkalarının görmesini amaçlayan eylemi ve izleyiciye bağlı sürdürmeyi merkez alması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin kendisini ilgilendirmeyen işe girişmesini ve genel yapmacıklığı da kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal başkalarının önünde doğal olmayan davranış sergilemeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda görülme amacı zorunludur; komşu dal daha geniştir ve görülme amacı bulunmadan da gereksiz işe girişme veya yapmacıklık bildirebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin kendi eylemini başkalarının bakışına göre düzenlemesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir adın, haberin veya ünün insanlar arasında yayılıp duyulması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da başkalarının kişiden haberdar olmasıyla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal amaçlı bir davranış biçimidir; komşu dal ise kişinin veya haberin toplum içinde duyulması ve yayılması sonucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; içi dışından farklı gösterme, belirli yapmacık roller, genel yapmacıklık ve ün yayılması seçildi, öteki adaylar bu sınırları daha az doğrudan gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه فعل الشيء ليراه الناس والمراءاة والرياء والسمعة
branches.source_phrase_ar: وراءى فلان يرائي وفعل ذلك رئاء الناس وهو أن يفعل شيئا ليراه الناس (maqayis)؛ فلان مراء والاسم الرياء وفعل ذلك رياء وسمعة (sihah)؛ يرآءون الناس إذا أبصرهم الناس صلوا وإذا لم يروهم تركوا الصلاة (tahdhib)؛ فعل ذلك رئاء الناس أي مراءاة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir güzel görünüş anlamından daha geniştir: dış görünüşü ve yüzde beliren niteliği, görüntüyü gösteren aynayı ve iyi ya da kötü görünüm değerlendirmelerini birlikte kaydeder. Bu nedenle dal, yalnız güzellik değil, göze sunulan görünüş ve onu görünür kılan araç ekseninde yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görünüş ile ayna, güzel dış görünüş ve yüzdeki belirtiyi bildiren bağlı birimler ayrı yüzeyler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin göze sunduğu dış görünüş ya da yüzünde okunabilen belirti ve bu görünüşü görüntü olarak yansıtan araçtır. Güzellik, parlaklık veya budalalık bu görünür yüzün ayrı değerlendirmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin göze görünen dış yüzü, durumu veya belirtisi.
Şeylerin görüntüsünü gösteren yansıtıcı araç.
Dış görünüşü güzel, parlak, çirkin veya budalaca diye değerlendirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, görüntüyü gösteren aynayı, göze görünen dış durumu, güzel görünüşü ve yüzde okunan olumsuz bir belirtiyi ortak görünürlük ekseninde bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın dış görünüş, görünür nitelik ve görüntüyü gösteren araç yüzeylerini birlikte belirtmek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görünür yüzü, onda okunan niteliği ve görüntüyü yansıtan aracı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin, giysinin veya eşyanın göze hoş görünen dış durumu anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu dış görünüş ve güzellik değerlendirmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ayna ve olumsuz yüz belirtisi anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya nesnenin görüntüsünü yansıtan araç kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görüntüyü görünür kılan yansıtıcı araç anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Dış görünüşün niteliğini ve yüzdeki belirtileri kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: göze güzel görünen durum veya donanım

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Aynayı ve yüzde okunan olumsuz bir belirtiyi güzel görünüşün yanında kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Görünüşün özellikle dolgun, canlı ve güzel oluşunu kendi çekirdeğine alması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dıştan görülen güzellik ve hoş görünüş alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görünüşü olumlu veya olumsuz değerlendirebilir ve aynayı da kapsar; komşu dal güzel, canlı ve dolgun görünüşle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yansıtıcı aracı ve genel güzel görünüşü yüz belirtisinin yanında kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüzün veya canlının rengi, izi ve ayırt edici görünür durumunu özellikle merkez alması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yüzde veya dış yüzeyde görülen durum ve niteliği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aynaya ve genel dış güzelliğe kadar uzanır; komşu dal yüzün rengi, izi ve görünür durumu çevresinde daha sıkıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Araç, genel görünüş ve olumsuz belirtiyi birlikte kapsayan geniş görsel alan.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Açık yüzlülük, güler yüz ve güzel beden görünüşünü olumlu insan niteliği olarak bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal olumlu yüz görünüşü ve güzel dış durumla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görünüşün kendisini ve aynayı anlatır; komşu dal yüz açıklığını ve güzel görünüşü kişiye özgü olumlu bir nitelik olarak anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi; güzel görünüş, yüzün görünür durumu ve güler yüz en yararlı ayrımları verdi, diğer adaylar tek örnek veya daha uzak bir görünüş alanında kaldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المرآة التي ينظر فيها وحسن المرأى والرواء والرئي وما يظهر على الوجه من علامة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرئي ما رأت العين من حال حسنة والرواء حسن المنظر والمرآة معروفة (maqayis)؛ المرآة التي ينظر فيها والري ما أريت القوم من حسن الشارة والهيئة والرواء حسن المنظر (ayn)؛ المرآة التي ينظر فيها والمرآة المنظر الحسن والرواء حسن المنظر ورأوة الحمق (sihah)؛ الرئي المنظر والرواء حسن المنظر والمرآة التي ينظر فيها ورأوة أي نظرة ودمامة (tahdhib)؛ المرآة ما يرى فيه صورة الأشياء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çoğunlukla aybaşı kanamasının ardından görülen az sarı, beyaz veya bulanık izi anlatır; bir kaynak aynı adla kanama ile temiz dönemi ayırt etmeye yarayan bezi de kaydeder. Bu araç anlamı, bedensel izin kendisiyle özdeşleştirilmeden bağlı bir uzantı olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin bildirdiği aybaşı izi temel alınır; araç anlamı kaynakça kayıtlı bir uzantı olarak açıkça ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Aybaşı kanamasının ardından görülen az miktardaki sarı, beyaz veya bulanık izdir. Kanama ile temiz dönemi ayırt etmek için kullanılan bez de aynı adın araç bildiren uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: Aybaşı kanamasından sonra görülen az sarı, beyaz veya bulanık iz.
Kanama ile temiz dönemi ayırt etmeye yarayan denetleme bezi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi aybaşıyla bağlantılı az renkli izi ortaklaştırır ve ayrıca kanama durumunu anlamaya yarayan bezi araç anlamı olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: aybaşı sonu izi ve denetleme bezi
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bedensel izin hem de kanama durumunu ayırt etmeye yarayan bezin birlikte açıklanması gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Renkli iz çekirdeğini ve araç bildiren bez uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kanamanın sonunda görülen az sarı, beyaz veya bulanık bedensel iz kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel izin zamanı, azlığı ve renk niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kanama durumunu denetlemeye yarayan bez anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: aybaşı sonrası hafif sarı, beyaz veya bulanık iz

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kanamanın ardından kalan az sarı, beyaz veya bulanık izi bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aybaşı kanamasının kendisini, kanını ve kanama durumundaki kadını genel olarak adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: aybaşı sonu izi ile aybaşı kanaması
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kadın bedenindeki aybaşı süreciyle doğrudan ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kanamanın kendisi değil, özellikle sonrasında görülen az renkli izdir; komşu dal kanama olayını ve kanını genel olarak kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gözle seçilen az renkli kalıntıyı veya bunu denetleyen bezi adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kanama, temiz dönem ve iki dönem arasındaki zaman birimini çok anlamlı bir adla bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aybaşı ile temiz dönem arasındaki sınırı belirlemede kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal somut iz veya denetleme aracıdır; komşu dal kanama ya da temiz döneminin kendisini ve bunların zaman aralığını adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel aybaşı kanaması ve dönem adı odak dalın artık iz ile araç sınırını en iyi gösterdi, öteki adaylar ilgisiz kumaş veya beden alanlarındaydı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما تراه المرأة من صفرة أو بياض أو خرقة تعرف بها حيضها من طهرها
branches.source_phrase_ar: الترئية والترية ما تراه الحائض من صفرة بعد دم حيض أو أمارات الحيض (maqayis)؛ الترية الخرقة التي تعرف بها المرأة حيضها من طهرها والماء الأصفر عند انقطاع الدم (jamhara)؛ الترية الشيء الخفي اليسير من الصفرة والكدرة (sihah)؛ الترية ما تراه المرأة من بقية حيضها من صفرة أو بياض (tahdhib)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجني الذي يعرض للإنسان أو يريه كهانة وطبا

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi solukla ilişkili organı, bu organın çoğulunu ve aynı addan türeyen organa vurma ya da organın ağrımasından yakınma eylemlerini açıkça birleştirir. Görme ve görünmez varlık anlamları yalnız biçim yakınlığı taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın organ adı ile organa vurma ve organın ağrımasını bildiren bağlı eylemler ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kalpten yayılan ve soluk alıp vermeyle ilişkili göğüs içi organdır. Türemiş kullanımlar bu organa vurmayı ya da organın ağrımasından yakınmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Soluk alıp vermeyle ilişkili, göğüste bulunan çift organ.
Bu organa vurma, onu yaralama veya ağrısından yakınma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar solukla ilişkili organı ortak biçimde tanır; organa darbe gelmesini ve organ ağrısından yakınmayı bildiren türemiş eylemler de aynı toplu kayıtta yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Organ adı ile bu organa vurma veya ağrıma türevlerinin ortak alanını açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Organ çekirdeğini ve organa yönelik zarar ya da ağrı uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca solunum organının kendisi veya çoğulu kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göğüsteki solunum organı çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Organa vurma ve organ ağrısından yakınma türevlerini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Solunum organının kendisini ve doğrudan ona gelen zarar ya da ağrıyı merkez alması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boğaz ucu, yemek borusu, üst göğüs ve iç boşluk gibi komşu beden bölümlerini de kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: akciğer ile üst göğüs içi bölgesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal akciğer ve soluk yoluyla ilişkili göğüs içi beden alanına dokunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli organla sınırlıdır; komşu dal organın yanında boğaz, yemek borusu ve üst göğüs çevresini daha geniş bir beden bölgesi olarak kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Solunum organını ve ona gelen darbe ya da ağrıyı bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karın içindeki başka bir organı ve ona özgü vurma, ağrı ve hastalığı bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal iç organı ve o organa gelen zarar ya da hastalığı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal göğüsteki solunum organıdır; komşu dal karındaki karaciğerdir, dolayısıyla ortaklık yalnız beden organı alanındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir organın adı ile organa doğrudan isabet veya organ ağrısını kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boğazı ve başı tutan belirli bir hastalık ya da sıkıştırıcı rüzgarı adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal solunumla bağlantılı beden bölgesinde hastalık veya zarar anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal organın kendisidir ve zarar türevleri vardır; komşu dal boğazda görülen belirli bir hastalığın adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; üst göğüs içi bölgesi, başka bir iç organ ve boğaz hastalığı organ, yer ve rahatsızlık sınırlarını gösterdi, kalan adaylar daha uzak beden parçalarıydı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرئة وجمعها وما يصيب الرئة أو يشتكيها
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرئة موضع الريح والنفس وجمعها الرئات والرئين (ayn)؛ الرئة مهموزة وتجمع على رئين ورأيته أي أصبت رئته (sihah)؛ أرأى إذا اشتكى رئته (tahdhib)؛ الرئة العضو المنتشر عن القلب ورئته إذا ضربت رئته (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dişi deve veya koyunda gebeliğin, doğum yaklaşırken memenin büyümesi ya da süt indirmesiyle görünür hale gelmesini bildirir. Genel gebelik, yalnız süt verme ve meme hastalığı bu belirti birleşiminden daha geniş veya farklıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca dişi deve ve koyunda gebeliği meme gelişmesiyle belli eden kayıtlı eylem birimleriyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Dişi deve veya koyunda gebeliğin, doğum yaklaşırken memenin büyümesi ya da süt indirmesiyle dışarıdan belli olmasıdır. Hayvan türü ve meme belirtisinin biçimi kayıtlı kullanıma göre değişir.

facets.statement: Gebeliğin doğum öncesi meme gelişmesiyle görünür hale gelmesi.
Dişi devede memenin süt indirmesiyle doğumun yaklaştığının anlaşılması.
Dişi koyunda memenin büyümesiyle gebeliğin ve yaklaşan doğumun belli olması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi gebeliğin görünürleşmesini meme gelişmesine bağlar; dişi devede sütün inmesi ve doğumun yaklaşması, dişi koyunda memenin büyümesi öne çıkar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dişi deve veya koyunda doğum öncesi gebelik belirtisinin memede görünmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gebeliği, görünürleşmeyi ve meme gelişmesi koşulunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın gebeliğinin, doğum öncesinde memesindeki değişiklikten anlaşılması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğum yakınlığını, meme gelişmesini ve gebeliğin anlaşılmasını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dişi devenin gebeliği memesi gelişince belli oldu
dişi koyunun gebeliği memesi büyüyünce belli oldu

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dişi koyunu da kapsaması ve meme gelişmesini görünür gebelik belirtisi olarak zorunlu tutması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dişi devenin gebeliğinin herhangi bir yolla belli olmasını daha genel biçimde anlatması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: meme belirtisiyle gebelik ile belli gebelik
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal dişi devenin gebeliğinin dışarıdan anlaşılır hale gelmesini kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görülüp tanınması için dikilen bayrak veya işareti açıkça tanımlar ve aynı biçim çevresinde bayrağı yere dikme eylemini kaydeder. Genel işaret, görme eylemi ve görüş anlamı bu özel nesne kimliğinden ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın bayrak adı ile bayrağı dikmeyi bildiren kayıtlı eylem ayrı tutulur ve genel görme anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Uzaktan görülüp bir topluluğu, yeri veya tarafı tanıtsın diye yüksek ve görünür bir yere dikilen bayrak ya da belirgin işarettir. Türemiş kullanım bu bayrağı yere dikip sabitlemeyi bildirir.

facets.statement: Görülüp tanınmak üzere yüksek ve görünür yere dikilen bayrak.
Bayrağı yere dikip görünür biçimde sabitleme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bayrağı görülmek için dikilen belirgin işaret olarak ortaklaştırır; bayrağın yere dikilmesini bildiren eylem de aynı toplu kaydın bağlı uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir topluluğu, yeri veya tarafı uzaktan tanıtan dikili bayrak kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bayrak nesnesini, dikili oluşunu ve görülme amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam nesnenin dikili ve tanıtıcı işlevini zaten açıkça gösterdiğinde kısa karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Görülmek üzere dikilme amacını tek başına açıkça söylemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlamaktır. Ayna tutma bu çekirdeğin araçlı gerçekleşimidir; ver veya uzat buyruğu kalıplaşmış bir alışveriş kullanımı, bir olay üzerinden ders gösterme ise soyut uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca gösterme, ayna tutma, verme buyruğu ve ibret verici durum bildiren kayıtlı yapılarda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkasının görüş alanına getirip onu görmesini veya kavramasını sağlamaktır. Ayna tutma, bir şeyi uzatmayı isteyen kalıp ve bir kişi üzerinden başkalarına sonuç gösterme bu nedensel çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlama.
Birinin kendisini görmesi için ona ayna tutma.
Verme buyruğu veya bir olay üzerinden sonuç ve bilgi gösterme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi başkasının görmesini sağlayan göstermeyi ortak eksen yapar; ayna tutma, alışverişte ver buyruğu ve bir olayla sonuç ya da bilgi gösterme ayrı bağlı kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesne, görüntü veya bilginin başkasına görünür ya da kavranır kılındığı nedensel kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Gösterilen şeyi, gösteren kişiyi ve gören alıcıyı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin kendi görüntüsünü görmesi için ona ayna tutulduğu özel yapıda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlatı, haber veya şiiri başkasına aktarmayı ve bir kişiye şiiri aktararak ezberletmeyi açıkça bir arada sunar. Haber getirme ile su getirme arasındaki açıklama kökensel bir benzetmedir, dalın çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, aktarma çekirdeğini anlatı ve şiir yapıları ile ezberletmeye yönelik ettirgen yapı arasında açıkça böler.

concept_map.definition: Bir anlatıyı, haberi veya şiiri başkasına sözlü olarak aktarmaktır. Birine şiiri tekrar ederek ezberletmek ve çok aktaran kişiyi adlandırmak bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, alınmış bir haber, anlatı veya şiiri başkasına iletmektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kaynak içeriği, haber, anlatı ve şiirin bir aktarıcıdan başkasına iletilmesini; ayrıca şiirin ezberlenmesi için başkasına öğretilmesini kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Aktarılan içeriğin haber, anlatı ya da şiir olduğu genel iletim bağlamlarında dalın çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Önceden alınan sözlü içeriğin bir başkasına iletilmesi çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir haberin veya geleneksel anlatının kaynaktan alınarak başkasına iletildiği bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir içeriği kaynağından alıp başkasına iletme işlemini korur.
error_profile.adds: Tek başına kullanıldığında yazılı aktarım ve fiziksel taşıma anlamlarını da çağırabilir.
error_profile.collision: Genel taşıma ve yazılı kopyalama anlamlarıyla karışabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şiirin tekrar edilerek başka bir kişinin belleğine yerleştirildiği özel yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aktarım yoluyla başkasının içeriği öğrenmesini sağlar.
error_profile.loses: Genel haber ve şiir iletimini yalnız öğrenme sonucuna indirger.

error_profile.preserves: Sözlü olarak başkasına içerik iletme yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Aktarılan bir kaynağa dayanmayan özgün açıklama veya kurgu anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Açıklama yapma ve öykü kurma eylemleriyle karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şiir aktarımını, çok aktaran kişiyi ve birine şiir ezberletmeyi açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aktarılan sözün kalıcı mirasa dönüşmesini ve yazıya geçirilmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da önceden alınmış sözlü bilginin sonraki kişilere iletilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aktarım eylemi ve aktarıcı rolündedir; komşu dal ise içeriğin aktarılmış bir miras olarak kalıcılaşmasına da uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İçeriği bilen kişiden dinleyiciye doğru aktarma yönünü temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sözü alma, öğrenme ve öğreticiden edinme yönünü temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Öğretme ve ezberletme durumunda aynı sözlü iletim olayının iki yönünü gösterirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iletici tarafın eylemini, komşu dal ise alıcı tarafın sözü edinmesini anlatır; bu nedenle olağan bağlamda birbirinin yerine geçmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sekiz dış aday ve on dört kardeş dal tek tek değerlendirildi; aktarımı kalıcı mirastan ve alıcı yönlü öğrenmeden ayıran iki aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نقل الحديث والشعر والخبر، وكثرة الرواية، وتروية غيره الشعر حتى يحفظه

root_profile.summary: Kök, suya kanma ve su taşıma çevresinden söz aktarma, düşünerek değerlendirme, ihtiyaç, kalan miktar, yük bağı, yapı bağımlı dolgunluk, görünüş, koku, hayvan, bayrak, uyak harfi, yağmur bulutu ve toplumsal yük taşıyan önderlere uzanan çok sayıda bağımsız dal içerir. Dalların bir bölümü su, taşıma ve doluluk benzetileriyle tarihsel olarak ilişkilendirilebilse de çağdaş kavram haritasında ayrı sınırlar gerektirir.

contextual_glosses.text: içene yeten tatlı ve bol su
